description.subtitle: Women's Champions League adidas football 2025 2026 in size 5 - white, green
description.tagline: Inspirado en la gloria europea femenina
description.intro: The adidas Women's Champions League 25 26 League size 5 gives you the thrill of the most important female football competition. With its official design, rugged material and reliable performance, it is perfect for training or racing.
key_benefits: Iconic Design: Official graphics of the UEFA Women's Champions League with a unique and symbolic style.
Optimized durability: Seamless surface for a more precise trajectory, better touch and less water absorption.
Reliable touch: Butyl chamber that ensures prolonged air retention.
Versatilidad: Ideal para entrenamientos, partidos y uso recreativo.
Female Inspiration: The perfect ball to feel like a star in the Women's Champions League.
